result:
I’d break the link between bad luck and a ruined life.

Being born somewhere dangerous, getting sick, losing someone, making a mistake—those things could still hurt, sometimes terribly, without costing a person every chance to build a good life.

Not a world without consequences or grief. A world with a floor beneath everyone, and a way back when they fall.
